verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's own marketing says merchants can receive one-off or recurring payments through a unique payment link, so the core capability is documented. The evidence does not say the link is created from the dashboard without code, and it gives no setup steps or time-to-first-sale detail. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard-based no-code link creation flow, documentation of setup steps or sharing options, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: Receive one-off or recurring payments from anyone, anywhere, via your unique payment link.
